shell.update.installNote: Update downloads the new version, checks that it really comes from us and installs it over this one. Your settings are kept and the program starts again. Nothing is downloaded until you choose.

shell.tooltips.delayedNote: A tooltip shows after the pointer has rested on a control for 1 second. Everywhere in the program.
